data.desc: Dana Incorporated (NYSE: DAN) is a global leader in the design and manufacture of highly efficient propulsion solutions for the light- and commercial vehicle markets. Guided by its vision to be the world's best powertrain company, Dana delivers advanced conventional and clean energy technologies that help customers improve the performance, efficiency, and durability of their vehicles. The company supplies leading vehicle manufacturers and related aftermarkets with industry defining drive systems, electrodynamic technologies, and thermal and sealing solutions.
